title: Implement --incomplete flag — list all incomplete tasks
description: When --incomplete flag is set, read tasks.json, filter to incomplete tasks, and print one line per task. Combine with --category to filter further.
acceptanceCriteria: rocket status --incomplete prints one line per incomplete task
rocket status --incomplete --category config shows only config tasks

steps.details: In statusCommand: if (options.incomplete) { let tasks = await readTasks(agentDir); tasks = getIncompleteTasks(tasks); if (options.category) tasks = tasks.filter(t => t.category === options.category); tasks.forEach(t => console.log(`#${t.id} · ${t.title} [${t.category}]`)); return }
Run `npm run dev -- status --incomplete` in a project with tasks. Verify the output format '#ID · title [category]'.
